State the day summary in one paragraph. Note the main activities
and any incidents.

# Activity log

Record the activities in chronological order. Use a table with
time, activity, and outcome columns.

# Incidents

List any incidents, near misses, or safety events. For each, state
what happened and the action taken.

# Follow-up

List the follow-up items with owners and due dates.
